description: Tonnes of hot mix asphalt for a paving area, or cubic metres and truck loads of ready-mix concrete for a slab, footing or column. Every parameter is optional and has a default. Material estimate from the numbers entered. It is not a quote and does not include base, forming, reinforcing or site conditions.

area.description: Total paving area, used when how=area. Unit: sq ft or m2.

count.description: Number of columns or piers, used when shape=col.

density.description: Compacted asphalt density. 2350 kg/m3 equals 110 lb per square yard per inch. Unit: kg/m3.

diameter.description: Column diameter, used when shape=col. Unit: ft or m.

height.description: Column height or depth, used when shape=col. Unit: ft or m.

how.description: Enter the paving area as length and width (lw) or as a total area (area).

length.description: Length of the paving area or slab. Unit: ft or m.

shape.description: Slab or footing (slab), or round column or pier (col).

thickness.description: Compacted asphalt thickness, or concrete slab thickness. Unit: in or mm.

waste.description: Waste allowance on the concrete order. Unit: percent.

width.description: Width of the paving area or slab. Unit: ft or m.

name: asphalt_concrete_calculator
title: Asphalt and Concrete Calculator
